messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: HIGH - service=model-routing - trigger_id=PD12345 - High rate of 5xx responses on /v1/generate. Escalation policy: eng-oncall -> SRE -> runtime.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident PD12345 created and routed to eng-oncall.

Olivia (oncall): Acked. I'm pulling traces and recent catalog promotions. Any recent deploys? :eyes:

Liam (SRE): I see spike at 09:12 UTC. Error: "tokenizer mismatch" in model-serving logs. Stack snippet: `ValueError: tokenizer vocabulary size mismatch (expected 50257, got 32000)`. 5xxs mostly 502/503.

Rami (runtime): That smells like a model catalog promotion shipped a revision that uses a different tokenizer. Checking catalog change stream...

Rami (runtime): Found recent promotion at 09:08 UTC: catalog.model_id=redwood/gpt-alpha default_revision set to "rev-2026-03-09-b" by CI rollout job. The previous default was "rev-2026-02-28-stable".

Maya (PM): That promotion went through the automated canary job (small %). Did the canary succeed?

Rami (runtime): Canary reported green on throughput metrics but evasion tests didn't include tokenization checks. Looks like artifact built with a different tokenizer (maybe mixed vocab).

Erin (support): Customer James reports increased error rate and timeouts in production. He pasted logs showing 502s starting ~09:10 UTC.

James (customer): Confirming. Our integrations began failing; we had to fall back. Happy to share logs if needed.

Olivia (oncall): Impact: partial customer-facing failures on hosted API for calls routed to gpt-alpha default route. Scope: estimate ~3% of traffic hitting the promoted revision, errors concentrated on sequences with long prompt tokens.

Liam (SRE): Initiating mitigation. Options: 1) Rollback catalog default_revision to previous stable. 2) Add runtime routing override to send all traffic for that model to rev-2026-02-28-stable. 3) Hotpatch tokenizer compatibility shim (risky).

Olivia (oncall): Let's do fastest safe: routing override + rollback. Rami, can you push override and coordinate rollback? I'll escalate PD to SRE lead if needed.

Rami (runtime): On it. Applying runtime route-override: `POST /admin/v1/route-override {"model_id":"redwood/gpt-alpha","target_revision":"rev-2026-02-28-stable","force":true}`.

Rami (runtime): Command output:
```
200 OK
applied route override id=ovr-9876
message: routing override applied, rebalancing
```

Liam (SRE): Watching metrics... 5xx rate dropping in the next minute.

Olivia (oncall): Good. Rami, please also trigger catalog rollback change so default_revision is restored and CI/promote won't reapply the bad rev.

Rami (runtime): Creating catalog rollback PR and applying immediate PATCH via catalog API: `PATCH /catalog/v1/models/redwood/gpt-alpha {"default_revision":"rev-2026-02-28-stable","note":"emergency rollback - tokenizer mismatch"}`.

Rami (runtime): PATCH response: `202 Accepted`, propagation to control plane underway.

Erin (support): Confirmed with James: traffic successful again after ~09:17 UTC. They see normal responses.

James (customer): Yes, traffic looks normal now. Thanks for the rapid response.

Olivia (oncall): PD: mark incident acknowledged -> mitigated. Liam, flag for postmortem and severity. Maya, please coordinate comms if we need customer-facing note.

Liam (SRE): Setting incident state to mitigated in PD. Logging details. Action items recorded.

Maya (PM): Will draft an internal note for impacted customers and coordinate with CS. Need root cause analysis before external comms.

Rami (runtime): Quick root cause: build pipeline for rev-2026-03-09-b pulled tokenizer artifacts from a different branch with a smaller vocab; promotion didn't validate tokenizer size compatibility with current serving runtime. Fixes: 1) Add tokenizer-vocab-size check in promote pipeline. 2) Add model-catalog promotion gating test that runs a tokenization roundtrip on representative prompts. 3) Ensure rollback removes route-override when propagation completes.

Olivia (oncall): Temporary post-incident checklist:
- Confirm rollback fully propagated and override removed.
- Run regression tests on rev-2026-02-28-stable.
- Create follow-up tickets for pipeline checks.
- Postmortem within 48h.

Liam (SRE): Confirming rollback propagation: catalog reports default_revision=rev-2026-02-28-stable across regions at 09:25 UTC. Scheduling removal of the route override after 1 hour of stable metrics.

Rami (runtime): Will remove override at 10:25 UTC if 5xx rate remains low. Will also upload the promotion artifact and tokenizer diffs to the incident ticket.

Erin (support): Notifying affected customers list and tagging for follow-up.

Maya (PM): Assigning postmortem: maya/rami/liam/olivia/erin. Target: write-up + action plan in 48h.

Olivia (oncall): Handing off to SRE for follow-up. If pager re-fires, escalate to SRE lead. Good job team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident PD12345 transitioned to STATUS: mitigated by Olivia (oncall).

Liam (SRE): Follow-up note: we'll add a canary tokenizer assert to the promote job and add extra webhook to block promotions where tokenizer size differs from previous stable.

Olivia (oncall): Closing thread, will attach logs and notes to the PD ticket and the catalog change.

Maya (PM): ETA for external customer note by EOD tomorrow.

Rami (runtime): Uploading artifacts now.

Erin (support): Closing customer loop with James.

James (customer): Appreciate the quick fix. Please let us know next steps so we can avoid future disruptions.

Olivia (oncall): Will summarize in the postmortem. Thanks everyone.
